product.title: Mangrove Kayaking Adventure in Singapore

description.text: In Singapore, this four-hour guided kayak session leaves a Pulau Ubin shophouse near the jetty for an open-sea crossing and mangrove-forest channels. Tandem kayaks, personal flotation devices, lockers, drinking-water refills, and a rinse-off are listed. No prior kayaking experience is required. The Changi Point ferry is at guest expense. Commentary stays on mangrove birds such as kingfishers, eagles, and herons rather than a downtown bike loop. Sessions run morning or afternoon from shophouse No. 34. The format suits visitors who want a guided island paddle without renting kayaks independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Pulau Ubin and the mangrove forest that define this outing rather than a Marina Bay night ride.

highlights: Guided tandem kayak on Pulau Ubin mangrove channels
Open-sea crossing then calm forest water
Kayak, PFD, lockers, and rinse-off included

start.description: Adventures by Asian Detours, 34 Pulau Ubin, Singapore 508287. After Ubin Jetty, walk toward the welcome sign, turn left past bicycle rental shops to the green-and-white shophouse.

end.description: Return to your Singapore meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
